title: The Non-capitalist Solution to the Housing Crisis
summary: About Here looks at the housing crisis and argues for non-market solutions such as co-op and social housing, drawing on Vancouver's situation. It discusses how public supply can hold down rents.
why: Recommended in housing threads as a decent dive into the problem and possible long-term solutions.
